stem.text: Cancer cells may divide by far more divisions than other cells found in humans.
Which statement about cancer cells is correct?

A.text: They are able to synthesise the enzyme telomerase.

B.text: They have a mutation in the telomeres so DNA is not hydrolysed.

C.text: They have DNA polymerase so can replicate their DNA without telomere loss.

D.text: They increase the number of copies of repeated DNA sequences in the telomeres.
